glossary.PMS: property management system (your main booking system)

scoring.score: floor(100 * sum(weight*factor) / sum(weight)) over visible, applicable (not Doesn't apply) scored questions
verdict_order: 1 Soft stop: s1 or s2 answered No -> short result with alternatives; 'Continue anyway' resumes and caps the final verdict at Almost ready.
2 Not enough info: Don't know yet on more than 50% of visible applicable scored questions.
3 Not ready: any blocker answered No, OR score < 50, OR fewer than half of visible applicable blockers answered Yes.

4 Ready: every visible blocker Yes or Doesn't apply, score >= 75, Don't know yet < 25%, s3-s5 all Yes, a listed use case chosen, every asked gate answered (not Don't know yet), no sensitive flag, no cap.
caps: sensitive flag (static or from a gate answer)
any gate answered Don't know yet
s3, s4 or s5 answered No or Don't know yet

none_fits.note: Asks all five library gates (exception to the 1-2 gate rule) because the use case is unknown.

questions.text: Has the department that will use the tool agreed to try it?
questions.why: Tools pushed on a team without its agreement go unused.

questions.text: Can the people using it tell when its result is wrong?
questions.why: Someone must catch mistakes before they matter.

questions.text: Do you know the monthly cost and any set-up fee?
questions.why: Hidden set-up fees often double the first-year cost.

questions.text: Can the tool get the data it needs from your systems without retyping?
questions.why: Retyping data removes most of the time saved.

questions.text: Is the information the tool works from written down and current?
questions.why: The tool repeats whatever it is given, right or wrong.

questions.text: Is it written down what the tool may and may not be used for?
questions.why: A clear purpose stops the tool drifting into risky uses.
